mapper.sql: id, email, scene, code_hash, expires_at, used, fail_count, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM email_verify_code WHERE email = #{email} AND scene = #{scene} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verify_code (id, email, scene, code_hash, expires_at, used, fail_count, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{scene}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{used}, #{failCount}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verify_code SET fail_count = fail_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE email_verify_code SET used = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
